entries.claim: Prints the complete hymn under n. 166 with Amen, in unaccented type with ae digraphs; every one of the 149 selected words stands in the same order.

locator.section: In Honour of the Blessed Sacrament, no. 5, Hymn of S. Thomas Aquinas

entries.claim: Prints the complete hymn with Amen, the first strophe under chant notation and the other six as text; every one of the 149 selected words stands in the same order, with j spellings.

locator.section: Gratiarum actio post Missam; Rhythmus S. Thomae Aquinatis; right column, seven strophes and Amen

entries.claim: Prints the complete seven-strophe Rhythmus S. Thomae Aquinatis with its closing Amen among the thanksgiving prayers after Mass. This page controls the selected letters, accents, capitals and punctuation of all 149 words; the heading and indulgence grant are not part of the text.

locator.section: Gratiarum actio post Missam; Rhythmus S. Thomae Aquinatis; right column, seven strophes ending Amen

entries.claim: This separately set manifestation prints the same 149 words in the same order. It spells súbicit and pelicáne, capitalizes Sánguine, sets a comma after intúeor and a semicolon after sítio, and prints Amen on the last verse line. It corroborates one received tradition, not independent historical transmission.

locator.section: n. 106, Hymn of St Thomas Aquinas; Latin column

entries.claim: The Latin column prints the complete hymn with Amen. It agrees with the selected text in every word except the accusative Jesum for the vocative Iesu at the head of the last strophe, and spells pelicane and pœnitens.
